title: Advanced Swift Language Features
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of advanced swift language features in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 19: Advanced Swift Language Features. Lessons in order: Macros in Swift; Property Wrappers; Result Builders; Subscripts and Custom Collection Interfaces; Advanced Protocol Witnesses and Dispatch; Advanced Initializers and Type Relationships; Metatypes and Dynamic Type Information; Reflection and Runtime Introspection; Custom Operators and Precedence Groups; Availability and Conditional Compilation; Swift Evolution and Language Proposals; C Interoperability; C++ and Other Language Interoperability; Modern Ownership and Low-Level Language Features.
